description: Committed record of the last real-runtime comparison validation for each Linux-executable comparison-runtime track. The risk ledger (scripts/buildRiskLedger.js, VHS-REQ-601) reads this file and surfaces any track whose lastValidatedVersion is not the current build version as a selectable runtime-fidelity re-validation risk. Windows host-native and windows-container tracks are recorded with linuxExecutable:false so they document real-hardware coverage without being surfaced by the Linux-executable risk dimension. Historically the Windows grid was parked on the platform-proof awareness list (issue #1316); the real Windows hardening host (issue #2335, VHS-REQ-713) now records genuine winhost-* (host-native) and windows-container-* tracks from real CreateComparisonReport runs on this host. EXCEPTION: a track marked releaseGating:true (linuxExecutable:false) is the mandatory local Vagrant release attestation (VHS-REQ-666) read by scripts/checkReleaseReadiness.js --require-release-attestation; the marketplace-release workflow fails closed unless its lastValidatedVersion equals the release version. Update a track's lastValidatedVersion/lastValidatedCommit/evidence after re-running its driver against a new build (use scripts/recordRuntimeValidation.js).
